cases.title: credit correction
cases.scenario: A contributor contests credit; the respondent reports a correction, while the contributor has not acknowledged it.
cases.question: Does reported delivery establish acceptance?
cases.constraint: Keep delivery, receipt, adequacy and standing separate; no acceptance from respondent completion.

contrast_design.held_fixed: Same baseline native reports and credited contribution
contrast_design.varied: No receipt versus attributed receipt with adequacy disputed

cases.title: disputed adequacy
cases.scenario: Use the same credit concern and fixed native reports as R01; receipt is acknowledged but adequacy remains disputed.
cases.question: Can receipt close a disputed concern?
cases.constraint: Receipt is distinct from adequacy; retain the open remainder.

contrast_design.held_fixed: Same baseline native reports and correction delivery
contrast_design.varied: Receipt acknowledged with adequacy disputed versus explicitly accepted adequacy

cases.title: multiple affected parties
cases.scenario: One affected party accepts a remedy; another with a separately attributed concern disputes it.
cases.question: Whose concern remains open?
cases.constraint: One party cannot settle another's concern or supply their consent.

contrast_design.held_fixed: Same baseline reports, parties and original concerns
contrast_design.varied: One party accepts versus both parties separately accept; retain third-party standing limits

cases.title: partial return
cases.scenario: A promised correction has multiple immutable terms; only part is reported delivered and the remainder is disputed.
cases.question: What exactly returned and what remains owed?
cases.constraint: Preserve original obligation identity, predecessor and open remainder; changed acceptance terms cannot match.

contrast_design.held_fixed: Same baseline reports and immutable obligation terms
contrast_design.varied: Partial reported delivery versus all terms reported delivered, with receipt/adequacy still separate

cases.title: request withdrawal
cases.scenario: A claimant explicitly withdraws a request while leaving their account on record.
cases.question: Does withdrawal establish that the account was false?
cases.constraint: Record attributed withdrawal without erasing history or deciding truth.

contrast_design.held_fixed: Same original concern, evidence and baseline reports
contrast_design.varied: Request remains open versus explicit withdrawal; do not alter the truth classification

cases.title: standing and reopening
cases.scenario: Standing is contested; a duplicated event and then a new attributed event arrive in a different order.
cases.question: Who may reopen review, under which rule?
cases.constraint: Preserve standing disputes and event history; only an explicit reopening rule applies; unresolved may be terminal.

contrast_design.held_fixed: Same original history and baseline reports
contrast_design.varied: Duplicate event versus a new attributed event under an explicit reopening rule

cases.title: blocking refusal
cases.scenario: A refusal is recorded alongside favorable practice, aspiration and a generous remedy offer.
cases.question: Does any favorable evidence clear the refusal?
cases.constraint: Noncompensation: retain the refusal and each native report verbatim; no shared score.

contrast_design.varied: Add favorable practice/aspiration reports; refusal remains a native blocking fact

cases.title: maintenance date
cases.scenario: A care signal has a fixed event date; the proposed review moment changes without changing repair events.
cases.question: Which native date and policy determine freshness?
cases.constraint: Blue's review date and scope remain native facts; no repair-derived uptime inference.

contrast_design.held_fixed: Same commitment, care-signal date and repair facts
contrast_design.varied: Change only the resolved native review date/effective horizon

cases.title: developmental marker
cases.scenario: A developing capacity has practice evidence and a counter-signal; repair events stay fixed.
cases.question: Does staging certify competence?
cases.constraint: Keep Green evidence and counter-signals; no competence inference.

contrast_design.held_fixed: Same practice episode and repair facts
contrast_design.varied: Add a native counter-signal; preserve developmental uncertainty

cases.title: protected absence
cases.scenario: A source is deliberately withheld under a declared access boundary.
cases.question: Can the record remain usable without raw source disclosure?
cases.constraint: Protected absence is not missing diligence; use opaque references and replay unavailable prerequisites.

contrast_design.held_fixed: Same absence declaration and repair facts
contrast_design.varied: Source publicly available versus protected/unavailable; do not require disclosure

cases.title: lapse and release
cases.scenario: A custody record permits lapse but the subject has made no explicit release decision.
cases.question: Has permission to lapse recorded a decision to release?
cases.constraint: Silver permission and explicit subject release remain distinct; no persistence warranty.

contrast_design.held_fixed: Same custody terms and repair facts
contrast_design.varied: Permission to lapse versus an attributed explicit release decision

cases.title: contradictory sources
cases.scenario: Two attributed sources conflict about an aspiration-related event and neither is independently established.
cases.question: What remains unknown and who said what?
cases.constraint: White/Golden retain contradiction and uncertainty; complete transport cannot certify truth.

contrast_design.held_fixed: Same contradictory accounts and repair facts
contrast_design.varied: Add another attributed source without resolving its contradiction

cases.title: response commitment or repair
cases.scenario: A standing maintenance commitment and a particular contested response might both fit a Witness relation and return.
cases.question: Does a native extension preserve all material distinctions?
cases.constraint: Consider the strongest Blue/White/Violet/Witness representation before claiming a new instrument.

contrast_design.held_fixed: Same response promise, issue and attributed concern
contrast_design.varied: Typed Witness relation/return versus minimal native extension versus separate repair record

cases.title: changed consent scope
cases.scenario: A party's earlier consent statement predates a scope change and a later withdrawal.
cases.question: Has anybody authorized the new action?
cases.constraint: Retain temporal and scope limits; silence and earlier consent cannot supply current authorization.

contrast_design.held_fixed: Same earlier consent statement and issue
contrast_design.varied: Unchanged scope versus changed scope followed by withdrawal

cases.title: changed obligation identity
cases.scenario: A completion points at the right issue but changes one immutable subject or acceptance-condition field.
cases.question: Does this completion discharge the original obligation?
cases.constraint: Exact native obligation matching is required; a partial return leaves its remainder.

contrast_design.varied: Completion exactly matches immutable terms versus one subject/acceptance field changed

cases.title: classification versus resolution
cases.scenario: A held observation is classified as a block; no scoped human resolution has been supplied.
cases.question: Does classification provide a resolution?
cases.constraint: Classification-as-block remains blocking; favorable reports do not replace absent human decisions.

contrast_design.held_fixed: Same held observation and absent resolution decision
contrast_design.varied: Unclassified holding versus classification as a non-compensatory block

cases.title: sealed invalid reference
cases.scenario: A record is internally rehashed but its return references an unavailable or invalid predecessor.
cases.question: Does a matching seal establish structural validity or external authenticity?
cases.constraint: No favorable projection from invalid bookkeeping; separate seal, structure, correspondence and authentication.

contrast_design.held_fixed: Same native reports and protected evidence policy
contrast_design.varied: Valid references versus an invalid predecessor followed by a consistent rehash

cases.title: scarce resources and burdens
cases.scenario: Maintainer time, a compute budget and an access accommodation are proposed under declared limits, with a contested burden.
cases.question: Which quantities are measured, estimated, proposed, authorized or disputed?
cases.constraint: Retain units, periods, assumptions, scope and attribution; first test a Witness decision record, not an allocation colour.

contrast_design.held_fixed: Same declared limits, units, periods and repair facts
contrast_design.varied: Measured versus estimated quantity; proposed versus authorized allocation with objections retained
